policy: Only named primitive implementation symbols receive diagnostic labels. Guest application bodies, hashed functions without a primitive rule, unknown addresses, and parser/interpreter application helpers remain unclassified. Microcase links identify related named primitives; sample fractions describe observed CPU hotspots and are not a measure of everyday-code representativeness or acceptance.
